title: It is not what I was looking for
contents: While the author talk a bit about studies and their significance she also mixes it with her own experiences and opinions. Lots of things are not said and kind of cherry picked (I never heard of breastfeeding and better friendship statement and don’t see how it is relevant in those discussions for example). Examples are often random and vague. Overall read it as an experience of another mother not like of an authority that will help you to make any decisions.

title: Great info
contents: Such useful information that have helped me navigate all the choices I am making in my first time pregnancy.

title: Very informative
contents: Great source for people like who like studies and data, clear and informative so you can take the best decision bad on your preferences

title: Incredibly helpful
contents: Data driven perspectives and personal anecdotes made this book insightful, interesting, and incredibly helpful.

title: Good tools and understanding
contents: This gave me more reality as a first time parent. It truly shows you other ways to do things and gave me the confidence as a new mom to raise an independent, strong child

title: Worth it
contents: This was a great purchase for us. Our little one is a great sleeper through the night (she’s 16 weeks) but will not fall asleep without 2 hours of rocking and bouncing. As far as naps go, she will only nap on someone. We chose to do SLIP just based on the timeframe and the tolerance and current sleep trends with our baby, and for bedtime it’s been working thus far! We’re on day four, and this book gave us all the tools to be successful without feeling guilty for letting our baby cry sometimes. We will start with naps in the next coming days, but are so grateful for the read! The comic relief is also worth noting and helpful when you’re making a decision about someone so important

title: Must read!
contents: Helped my little guy sleep independently at 4.5 months old. Can’t believe how easy it was to adjust his sleep associations at bed time, and now he puts himself to sleep. 10/10 definitely and must read for any tired parent!

title: Good info, worth skimming
contents: It’s helpful but jokes around way too much. Good information surrounded by filler. When you have a screaming infant that won’t sleep you also don’t have time for a self help book that won’t get to the point.

title: Book didn’t show, just the cover. Would give zero stars if I could.
contents: I’m so frustrated, my download was only the cover art. It’s not worth $15 to have five pictures of babies. I was really looking forward to this read.
